nodes.summary: An action of a group $G$ on a set $\Omega$ is sharply doubly transitive when for all points $\alpha, \beta, \gamma, \delta \in \Omega$ with $\alpha \ne \beta$ and $\gamma \ne \delta$ there is exactly one $g \in G$ with $g \cdot \alpha = \gamma$ and $g \cdot \beta = \delta$.
nodes.title: Sharply doubly transitive action

nodes.summary: The statement of Kourovka Problem 11.52 is false: there is a group $G$ acting sharply doubly transitively on a set $\Omega$ with at least two points such that no nontrivial normal subgroup of $G$ is abelian.
nodes.title: A sharply 2-transitive group without nontrivial abelian normal subgroups

nodes.summary: The statement that every group $G$ acting sharply doubly transitively on a set $\Omega$ with at least two points has a nontrivial abelian normal subgroup.
nodes.title: Mazurov's question on sharply 2-transitive groups (Kourovka 11.52)

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
